sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导者，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》

sentences.en: York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is a daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: We come on the air tonight after a massacre at an elementary school in Uvalde, Texas.
sentences.zh: 今晚我们播出的背景是德克萨斯州尤瓦尔迪一所小学发生的屠杀事件。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning, a gunman opened fire at the Robb Elementary School in Uvalde, Texas.
sentences.zh: 周二上午，一名枪手在德克萨斯州尤瓦尔迪的罗伯小学开枪射击。

sentences.en: This was supposed to be just two days before school got out.
sentences.zh: 这本应是学校放假前的最后两天。

sentences.en: This is supposed to be a joyous time right now.
sentences.zh: 这本应是一个欢乐的时刻。

sentences.en: We should be hearing kids laughing.
sentences.zh: 我们本该听到孩子们的笑声。

sentences.en: Right now, instead, we're seeing law enforcement swarming over the campus.
sentences.zh: 但现在，我们看到执法人员在校园里四处搜寻。

sentences.en: Killing at least 21 people, including 19 children.
sentences.zh: 造成至少21人死亡，其中包括19名儿童。

sentences.en: It's been more than 10 hours since this tragedy unfolded, and parents tonight are still trying to figure out what is happening with their children.
sentences.zh: 这场悲剧发生已经超过10个小时了，今晚家长们仍在试图弄清楚他们的孩子到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm looking for my daughter.
sentences.zh: 是的，我在找我的女儿。

sentences.en: I mean, after the shooting, they don't know where she's at.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，枪击事件发生后，他们不知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: I mean, the list, her name is not here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，名单上没有她的名字。

sentences.en: I'll look all night if I have to.
sentences.zh: 如果必须的话，我会找上一整晚。

sentences.en: It was the deadliest school shooting since the 2012 attack on the Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 这是自2012年康涅狄格州纽敦桑迪胡克小学袭击事件以来，最致命的校园枪击案。

sentences.en: My colleague, Elizabeth Williamson, has spent years talking with the
sentences.zh: 我的同事伊丽莎白·威廉姆森花了多年时间与

sentences.en: Sandy Hook parents who lost children that day.
sentences.zh: 那天失去孩子的桑迪胡克家长们交谈。

sentences.en: Today, what their experience tells us about what now awaits the parents in Texas.
sentences.zh: 今天，他们的经历告诉我们，德克萨斯州的家长们现在正面临着什么。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, May 25th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月25日，星期三。

sentences.en: Elizabeth, I think within moments of this shooting, so many of our minds immediately went to Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，我想在这次枪击事件发生后的瞬间，我们许多人的脑海里立刻就想到了桑迪胡克。

sentences.en: And I thought of you because you spent the past few years with several Sandy Hook parents
sentences.zh: 我想到你，是因为你过去几年与几位桑迪胡克的家长相处过，

sentences.en: who perhaps more than anyone else have some sense of what the parents in Texas are now going through.
sentences.zh: 他们或许比任何人都更了解德克萨斯州的家长们现在正在经历什么。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Within an hour or less after the news first started to trickle out of Texas that this was an
sentences.zh: 在德克萨斯州的消息刚开始传出，得知这是一起

sentences.en: elementary school shooting involving multiple victims who were children, I was corresponding and talking online with the Sandy Hook parents.
sentences.zh: 涉及多名儿童受害者的小学枪击案后不到一小时，我就在网上与桑迪胡克的家长们进行了交流。

sentences.en: They had this sense of numbness, a sense of what's wrong happening with a society in which 10 years later, this very same thing happens again.
sentences.zh: 他们感到一种麻木，一种对社会感到困惑的感觉——为什么10年后，同样的事情又发生了。

sentences.en: It's a very specific phenomenon that, you know, there is a growing fraternity of people in this country who
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常特殊的现象，你知道，在这个国家，有一个日益壮大的群体，他们

sentences.en: are the parents of children killed at school in mass shootings and relatives of people killed in mass shootings.
sentences.zh: 是那些在校园大规模枪击案中遇难儿童的父母，以及大规模枪击案中遇难者的亲属。

sentences.en: And, you know, they try to reach forward and help the latest set of survivors and, you know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们试图伸出援手，帮助最新的一批幸存者，你知道，

sentences.en: give them some comfort and tell them what to expect and offer themselves as a resource to people.
sentences.zh: 给他们一些安慰，告诉他们会发生什么，并作为一种资源提供给他们。

sentences.en: And Veronique de la Rosa, whose son Noah Posner died at Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮克·德拉罗萨，她的儿子诺亚·波斯纳在桑迪胡克遇难。

sentences.en: He was the youngest victim.
sentences.zh: 他是最年轻的受害者。

sentences.en: She told me that in those hours right after the shooting, when, you know, parents gathered in the firehouse
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，在枪击发生后的那几个小时里，当家长们聚集在学校附近的消防站，

sentences.en: near the school and they were waiting for news until they realized that they were the ones whose family members had died.
sentences.zh: 等待消息，直到他们意识到自己就是那些失去亲人的家庭成员时。

sentences.en: And she told me how she was so drawn to a woman who had appeared there or in the days thereafter, who had lost her own son to gun violence.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，她是如何被一位出现在那里或随后几天里出现的女性所吸引，那位女性也因枪支暴力失去了自己的儿子。

sentences.en: And she said, she just didn't want to let that person out of her sight.
sentences.zh: 她说，她只是不想让那个人离开她的视线。

sentences.en: You know, she really wanted to be near her, to hear her, to hear what she had to say,
sentences.zh: 你知道，她真的很想靠近她，听她说话，听她要说些什么，

sentences.en: because this was a kind of, you know, life raft for her, someone who had been through this and who knew
sentences.zh: 因为这就像是她的救生筏，一个经历过这一切并且了解

sentences.en: the desolation that Veronique was just beginning to experience and understand.
sentences.zh: 维罗妮克刚刚开始经历和理解的那种绝望的人。

sentences.en: What you are describing when you mentioned the firehouse, I remember this, you're referring to
sentences.zh: 你提到的消防站场景，我记得这个，你指的是

sentences.en: this almost unfathomably tragic scene of the parents at Sandy Hook gathered in one spot and being
sentences.zh: 桑迪胡克家长们聚集在一个地方，那种几乎无法想象的悲惨场景，在某些情况下

sentences.en: notified in some cases that their children had survived this terrible shooting and in some cases learning that their children did not.
sentences.zh: 被告知他们的孩子在这次可怕的枪击中幸存下来，而在另一些情况下得知他们的孩子没有幸存。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The firehouse was a scene that every parent and every family member described as absolutely gutting.
sentences.zh: 消防站的场景被每一位家长和家庭成员描述为绝对令人心碎。

sentences.en: It was the spot where children and educators who were evacuated gathered to be reunited with their family members.
sentences.zh: 那是撤离的儿童和教育工作者与家人团聚的地方。

sentences.en: And so consequently, as time went on, you know, this huge firehouse meant to hold eight trucks, this sort of cavernous space
sentences.zh: 因此，随着时间的推移，你知道，这个本可容纳八辆消防车的巨大消防站，这个巨大的空间，

sentences.en: was filled with sounds of reunion and relief and joy as people reunited with their family members.
sentences.zh: 充满了团聚、解脱和喜悦的声音，因为人们与家人重逢了。

sentences.en: And then the group began to dwindle as all those people went away and those who were still missing a
sentences.zh: 然后，随着所有那些人离开，人群开始减少，而那些仍然没有找到

sentences.en: family member gathered in the back and wrote the names of their loved one on a piece of notebook paper that was put there for that purpose.
sentences.zh: 家庭成员的人聚集在后面，在为此准备的笔记本纸上写下他们亲人的名字。

sentences.en: And police came, they asked them to describe what had your child been wearing, what had they been carrying, and they were working to identify the victims still in the school.
sentences.zh: 警察来了，他们要求描述孩子穿什么衣服、带什么东西，他们正在努力识别学校里剩下的受害者。

sentences.en: And it fell to the governor of Connecticut to tell them that if you're here and you've put your loved one's name
sentences.zh: 康涅狄格州州长不得不告诉他们，如果你在这里，并且把亲人的名字

sentences.en: on that list and you haven't been reunited with them, you will not be.
sentences.zh: 写在那份名单上，而你还没有与他们团聚，那么你将永远无法再见到他们。

sentences.en: And that was a moment of just incredible desolation.
sentences.zh: 那一刻充满了难以置信的绝望。

sentences.en: People just fell down wailing.
sentences.zh: 人们只是瘫倒在地，嚎啕大哭。

sentences.en: And Robbie Parker, whose daughter Emily died at Sandy Hook, you know, was telling me after the shooting in Texas
sentences.zh: 罗比·帕克，他的女儿艾米丽在桑迪胡克遇难，他在德克萨斯枪击案后告诉我，

sentences.en: that, you know, he has the urge to go and be there with those families because, you know, there are always people
sentences.zh: 你知道，他有一种冲动想去那里和那些家庭在一起，因为，你知道，总会有人

sentences.en: who will say to them, you can't imagine what they're going through.
sentences.zh: 对他们说，你无法想象他们正在经历什么。

sentences.en: But he said, what's really worse is that when you completely understand what they're going through because you've been there, but still there's nothing you can do.
sentences.zh: 但他表示，更糟糕的是，当你完全理解他们正在经历什么，因为你曾经身处其中，但你却无能为力。

sentences.en: That is their loss.
sentences.zh: 那是他们的损失。

sentences.en: You can help them to anticipate what they might feel, but they have still lost someone and in that they are, you know, unreachable.
sentences.zh: 你可以帮助他们预见可能会有的感受，但他们毕竟失去了某人，在这一点上，他们是无法被触及的。

sentences.en: And alone.
sentences.zh: 而且孤独。

sentences.en: And alone.
sentences.zh: 而且孤独。

sentences.en: And I wonder, Elizabeth, based on your conversations with these Sandy Hook parents through the years, what is coming for the parents in Texas?
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，根据你多年来与这些桑迪胡克家长的谈话，我想知道，德克萨斯州的家长们未来会面临什么？

sentences.en: What have you come to understand about the very specific grief and experience that comes with losing a child in this very particular, senseless, high-profile way?
sentences.zh: 你对以这种极其特殊、毫无意义、高调的方式失去孩子所带来的那种特定悲伤和经历，有什么理解？

sentences.en: I think one of the things that every parent and every Sandy Hook relative that I spoke with talks about is a loss of control.
sentences.zh: 我认为我交谈过的每一位桑迪胡克家长和亲属都会谈到的一件事就是失去控制感。

sentences.en: That the idea that the world is kind of spinning off its axis is really something that every one of them has described.
sentences.zh: 世界仿佛偏离了轨道，这确实是他们每个人都描述过的感觉。

sentences.en: Lenny Posner, who is Noah Posner's dad, described it as being a spectator to your own tragedy.
sentences.zh: 诺亚·波斯纳的父亲莱尼·波斯纳将其描述为自己悲剧的旁观者。

sentences.en: That there's media coverage, there's endless discussion, there are the thoughts and prayers that, you know, politicians send out in tweets or statements,
sentences.zh: 媒体的报道，无休止的讨论，政客们在推特或声明中发出的那些想法和祈祷，

sentences.en: and you're feeling like you're kind of watching it all unfold.
sentences.zh: 你感觉自己就像是在看着这一切发生。

sentences.en: And then there's just the grim business of planning a funeral and burying your child.
sentences.zh: 然后就是筹备葬礼和埋葬孩子的残酷现实。

sentences.en: And so that is something that permeates everything that comes after, whether it's the charitable response, what people send.
sentences.zh: 所以这渗透到了之后发生的一切，无论是慈善捐助，还是人们送来的东西。

sentences.en: What do people send?
sentences.zh: 人们送什么？

sentences.en: This is the thing, you know, when we have these mass shootings that affect children,
sentences.zh: 这就是问题所在，你知道，当我们发生这些影响儿童的大规模枪击事件时，

sentences.en: people kind of reflexively, as one parent put it, give, because they don't know what else to do.
sentences.zh: 正如一位家长所说，人们会下意识地捐赠，因为他们不知道还能做什么。

sentences.en: And we haven't, as a nation, shown that we're willing to take concrete policy action.
sentences.zh: 而作为一个国家，我们还没有表现出采取具体政策行动的意愿。

sentences.en: And it's just a sort of outpouring of toys, of teddy bears, of money.
sentences.zh: 这只是一种玩具、泰迪熊和金钱的涌入。

sentences.en: And there was a dispute over where the money was going and whether that money would directly benefit the victim's families, which it has been established, it should always do.
sentences.zh: 关于钱流向哪里，以及这笔钱是否会直接惠及受害者家庭，曾有过争议，而事实已经证明，这本应始终如此。

sentences.en: But not every charity raises money solely for the family's benefit.
sentences.zh: 但并非每个慈善机构筹集的资金都完全是为了受害者家庭。

sentences.en: They do it for their own community prograMs.
sentences.zh: 他们是为了自己的社区项目。

sentences.en: And that has created friction and tension and pain.
sentences.zh: 这造成了摩擦、紧张和痛苦。

sentences.en: So what seem like the good intentions of strangers in this outpouring of national grief ends up for the victim's families in a place like Sandy Hook, and presumably now in Texas,
sentences.zh: 因此，在全国性的悲伤浪潮中，陌生人的善意最终对于像桑迪胡克这样的受害者家庭，以及现在的德克萨斯州家庭来说，

sentences.en: to be its own kind of burden, liability, unwanted thing.
sentences.zh: 变成了一种负担、责任和不想要的东西。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And because the families weren't consulted when charities are established or money is raised or decisions are made about how to memorialize, what to do, quite rightly,
sentences.zh: 而且因为在建立慈善机构、筹集资金或决定如何纪念、做什么时，没有咨询家庭的意见，理所当然地，

sentences.en: the families say that they want a voice in all of that.
sentences.zh: 家庭成员表示他们希望在所有这些事情上有发言权。

sentences.en: Otherwise, they're having even more control and more agency torn away from them.
sentences.zh: 否则，他们会感到更多的控制权和自主权被剥夺了。

sentences.en: And that is an additional trauma.
sentences.zh: 这是一种额外的创伤。

sentences.en: They lose control over their loved ones' stories, their histories, you know, as they see them played out in the media.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了对自己亲人故事和历史的控制权，你知道，因为他们看着这些在媒体上被反复播放。

sentences.en: They lose control over how the response to the tragedy will go.
sentences.zh: 他们失去了对悲剧应对方式的控制权。

sentences.en: And they're very sensitive to that.
sentences.zh: 他们对此非常敏感。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And what else, based on your reporting, is coming for the families in Texas?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，德克萨斯州的家庭未来还会面临什么？

sentences.en: After every one of these mass shootings, but particularly school shootings involving children
sentences.zh: 在每一次大规模枪击事件之后，特别是涉及儿童

sentences.en: and children this age, there is an enormous debate and a heated battle over new gun legislation.
sentences.zh: 和这个年龄段儿童的校园枪击案，关于新枪支立法的辩论和激烈的斗争总是会发生。

sentences.en: And that rages for a while, and then it dies down without any real progress being made on that front.
sentences.zh: 这会持续一段时间，然后平息，而在这一方面并没有取得任何真正的进展。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: In the case of Sandy Hook, within one hour after the shooting, the NRA had compiled a list of potential legislation that would be proposed in Congress in response to the shooting.
sentences.zh: 在桑迪胡克的案例中，枪击发生后一小时内，全国步枪协会（NRA）就编制了一份清单，列出了国会为应对枪击事件可能提出的立法。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And they were fairly accurate.
sentences.zh: 而且他们相当准确。

sentences.en: Limits on large capacity magazines, background checks, mental health measures.
sentences.zh: 限制大容量弹匣、背景调查、心理健康措施。

sentences.en: And that was what the families were then faced with.
sentences.zh: 而这就是那些家庭随后所面临的。

sentences.en: Do we want to go to Washington and lobby for new gun legislation?
sentences.zh: 我们要去华盛顿游说新的枪支立法吗？

sentences.en: Do we want to be part of that debate to preserve our sanity and our privacy?
sentences.zh: 为了保持理智和隐私，我们想参与那场辩论吗？

sentences.en: Would we rather retreat from that debate?
sentences.zh: 我们宁愿退出那场辩论吗？

sentences.en: Do we favor the measures that are being proposed?
sentences.zh: 我们支持正在提出的措施吗？

sentences.en: Or do we oppose them?
sentences.zh: 还是我们反对它们？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And there was a sense that, by some, that the Sandy Hook families were a monolith, that they were lockstep in favor of this measure or that one.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为桑迪胡克的家庭是一个铁板一块的整体，他们在支持这项或那项措施上步调一致。

sentences.en: When, in fact, they had an enormous variety and range of opinions and feelings on this.
sentences.zh: 而事实上，他们对此有着极其多样和广泛的观点和感受。

sentences.en: And for some, it was an absolute priority.
sentences.zh: 对一些人来说，这是绝对的优先事项。

sentences.en: And for others, it was something that they didn't want to be involved in at all.
sentences.zh: 而对另一些人来说，这是他们根本不想参与的事情。

sentences.en: And again, speaking to that lack of control and that loss of agency,
sentences.zh: 再次回到那种缺乏控制和失去自主权的问题，

sentences.en: what really anchored some of them was the assumption by people involved in this debate or people with a gun legislation bent or an agenda that they could assume their support.
sentences.zh: 真正让他们感到困扰的是，参与这场辩论的人，或者那些有枪支立法倾向或议程的人，认为他们可以理所当然地获得他们的支持。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Or their opposition.
sentences.zh: 或者是他们的反对。

sentences.en: Their choice, they felt, was taken away from them.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己的选择被剥夺了。

sentences.en: And that really anchored them and, again, imposed an additional burden on them.
sentences.zh: 这确实让他们感到困扰，并再次给他们施加了额外的负担。

sentences.en: So, essentially, what you're describing is a world in which almost immediately, almost instantaneously,
sentences.zh: 所以，本质上，你所描述的是一个世界，几乎立刻，几乎瞬间，

sentences.en: the parents in Sandy Hook became these public symbols.
sentences.zh: 桑迪胡克的家长们就成了这些公众符号。

sentences.en: And as a result, they have almost no space to grieve or really make sense of the profound loss they've just experienced.
sentences.zh: 结果，他们几乎没有空间去哀悼，或者真正理解他们刚刚经历的深刻损失。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then there was an additional trauma, which was kind of related.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一种相关的额外创伤。

sentences.en: And that's that for a certain segment of Americans who were very much opposed to new gun legislation,
sentences.zh: 那就是对于某些非常反对新枪支立法的美国人来说，

sentences.en: denial that the shooting even happened became a kind of macabre tool in their toolkit.
sentences.zh: 否认枪击事件的发生变成了一种可怕的工具。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And back in the time of Sandy Hook in 2012, this was something utterly new that no one really expected.
sentences.zh: 回到2012年桑迪胡克时期，这完全是没人预料到的新事物。

sentences.en: There had been some claims around the Aurora shooting, which was several months before,
sentences.zh: 在几个月前的奥罗拉枪击案周围，曾有一些说法，

sentences.en: that this was a so-called false flag planned by the government as a pretext for confiscating Americans' firearMs.
sentences.zh: 称这是政府策划的所谓“假旗”行动，作为没收美国人枪支的借口。

sentences.en: But this false theory really gained traction around Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 但这种虚假理论在桑迪胡克事件周围真正获得了关注。

sentences.en: And it really made Sandy Hook kind of a foundational story in how misinformation and politically driven false narratives gained traction in our society.
sentences.zh: 它确实使桑迪胡克成为了错误信息和政治驱动的虚假叙事如何在我们的社会中获得关注的奠基性故事。

sentences.en: Because now it's not a bug as it was after Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 因为现在它不再像桑迪胡克之后那样是一个漏洞。

sentences.en: It is really a feature that recurs after almost every high-profile mass shooting.
sentences.zh: 它确实成为了几乎每起高调大规模枪击事件后都会重现的特征。

sentences.en: So, Elizabeth, are you saying that this is quite likely something that the parents in Texas
sentences.zh: 那么，伊丽莎白，你是说这很可能是德克萨斯州的家长们

sentences.en: will inevitably face in the days that follow, the denial that what they experienced actually happened?
sentences.zh: 在随后的日子里不可避免地会面临的事情，即否认他们所经历的事情真实发生过？

sentences.en: Yes, because the murder of children in a mass shooting is such a shock to the nation's system and such a potent argument for gun legislation that people who oppose that legislation
sentences.zh: 是的，因为大规模枪击案中儿童的谋杀对国家体制是一个巨大的冲击，也是支持枪支立法的有力论据，所以那些反对该立法的人

sentences.en: really find that a significant threat to their position.
sentences.zh: 确实认为这对他们的立场构成了重大威胁。

sentences.en: And so, for the segment of far-right people among that group, denying that the shooting ever happened
sentences.zh: 因此，对于该群体中的极右翼人士来说，否认枪击事件曾经发生过，

sentences.en: or spreading misinformation around it or accusing the federal government of staging it in service to gun control is a way to fight back against that potential for new legislation.
sentences.zh: 或者散布关于它的错误信息，或者指责联邦政府为了控枪而策划了这一切，是反击新立法潜力的一种方式。

sentences.en: And it's also a way to just muddy the waters around that debate, just to kind of, as Steve Bannon said,
sentences.zh: 这也是一种搅浑辩论水域的方式，正如史蒂夫·班农所说，

sentences.en: flood the zone with misinformation and lies so that people throw up their hands and say, what actually happened here?
sentences.zh: 用虚假信息和谎言淹没舆论场，让人们束手无策，感叹到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: Is there any possibility that this could have happened?
sentences.zh: 这事儿真的有可能发生吗？

sentences.en: And while that sounds outlandish to us, enough people will buy into that, that the families will endure
sentences.zh: 虽然这对我们来说听起来很荒谬，但会有足够多的人相信这一点，以至于受害者家属将不得不忍受

sentences.en: significant harassment, torment by people who will try to contact them on social media or will figure out where they live or how to reach them on the phone
sentences.zh: 严重的骚扰和折磨，人们会试图在社交媒体上联系他们，或者找出他们的住址，甚至通过电话骚扰他们，

sentences.en: and deny that they lost anyone and accuse them worse.
sentences.zh: 否认他们失去了亲人，并对他们进行更恶毒的指责。

sentences.en: You know, and this is a phenomenon that began with Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 要知道，这种现象始于桑迪胡克小学枪击案。

sentences.en: They are singled out by name as actors in a plot to impose gun control on Americans who don't want it.
sentences.zh: 他们被点名指控为一场阴谋的演员，目的是对不愿接受的美国人实施枪支管制。

sentences.en: And so they'll be targeted.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会成为攻击目标。

sentences.en: That, history tells us, is a fairly accurate prediction.
sentences.zh: 历史告诉我们，这是一个相当准确的预测。

sentences.en: I'd be pretty surprised if that didn't happen to these parents in Texas.
sentences.zh: 如果德克萨斯州的这些父母没有遭遇同样的情况，我会感到非常惊讶。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡，去探索《纽约时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I have to imagine, Elizabeth, that there were parents in Newtown who said, after everything you have just described, the charity efforts, the lobbying efforts,
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，我不得不想象，在纽敦的那些父母，在经历了你刚才描述的一切——慈善活动、游说努力、

sentences.en: the efforts at harassment, that they just needed to tune everything out, go into their house, close the door, and sit with their grief.
sentences.zh: 骚扰行为之后，他们一定只想屏蔽一切，回到家中，关上门，独自面对悲伤。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And I would say that described most of the parents, particularly when it did come to the misinformation campaigns and the conspiracy theories and the denials.
sentences.zh: 我想大多数父母都是这样，特别是在面对虚假信息运动、阴谋论和否认事实的言论时。

sentences.en: I'm thinking about Robbie Parker, who mentioned how in the beginning he just felt like, I am not going to engage with these bullies.
sentences.zh: 我想到罗比·帕克，他提到起初他觉得，我绝不会去理会这些恶霸。

sentences.en: I have two surviving children who are toddlers.
sentences.zh: 我还有两个蹒跚学步的孩子要抚养。

sentences.en: I need to care for my family.
sentences.zh: 我需要照顾我的家人。

sentences.en: I don't want to fight back.
sentences.zh: 我不想反击。

sentences.en: And even though he was absolutely targeted by name because he was the first parent to speak publicly after the shooting, he was really pursued, including in the real world,
sentences.zh: 尽管他因为是枪击案后第一个公开露面的家长而遭到点名攻击，甚至在现实生活中也遭到追逐，

sentences.en: by conspiracy theorists who confronted him years later.
sentences.zh: 被多年后仍对他进行当面质问的阴谋论者骚扰。

sentences.en: He was determined not to engage and to try and stay on the sidelines and protect his family.
sentences.zh: 他曾下定决心不参与其中，试图置身事外，保护家人。

sentences.en: But after 2018, when the Parkland shooting happened, he and his wife, Alyssa, were asked to meet and talk with a family who had lost their daughter at Parkland.
sentences.zh: 但在2018年帕克兰枪击案发生后，他和妻子艾丽莎被邀请去见一位在帕克兰失去女儿的家庭。

sentences.en: And the father described an analogous situation to what Robbie had gone through.
sentences.zh: 那位父亲描述的情况与罗比经历的如出一辙。

sentences.en: People confronting him, pointing to his public remarks and saying that they were evidence that he was lying and that he was an actor in a plot.
sentences.zh: 人们当面质问他，指着他的公开言论，说那是他撒谎的证据，说他是阴谋中的演员。

sentences.en: And Robbie realized this is not going away.
sentences.zh: 罗比意识到，这一切不会消失。

sentences.en: This is six years after Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 这已经是桑迪胡克事件六年之后了。

sentences.en: And it was then that he realized that he needed to join this fight against the conspiracy theorists and against the misinformation circulating around these mass shootings.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，他意识到自己必须加入这场对抗阴谋论和围绕这些大规模枪击事件传播的虚假信息的斗争。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And Elizabeth, have these parents, have they seen any change that might represent something positive coming out of such a horrific tragedy?
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，这些父母是否看到了任何可能代表从如此惨痛的悲剧中产生积极意义的变化？

sentences.en: Yes, they absolutely have, Michael.
sentences.zh: 是的，迈克尔，他们确实看到了。

sentences.en: So in mid-2018, the families filed four separate defamation lawsuits against Alex Jones, the Infowars broadcaster, who was the super spreader of Sandy Hook conspiracy theories,
sentences.zh: 2018年中期，这些家庭对亚历克斯·琼斯提起了四起独立的诽谤诉讼，他是Infowars的广播员，也是桑迪胡克阴谋论的超级传播者，

sentences.en: and an adamant pro-Second Amendment broadcaster.
sentences.zh: 同时也是一位坚定的支持第二修正案的广播员。

sentences.en: And late last year, he was found liable by default in all four.
sentences.zh: 去年年底，他在所有四起诉讼中都被判缺席审判败诉。

sentences.en: So that was a sweeping victory for the families.
sentences.zh: 这对这些家庭来说是一场彻底的胜利。

sentences.en: And this year, juries will decide how much Jones must pay the families in damages.
sentences.zh: 今年，陪审团将决定琼斯必须向这些家庭支付多少赔偿金。

sentences.en: So while the courts are an imperfect solution to this problem of misinformation, it's a significant deterrent to people who don't want to be sued.
sentences.zh: 虽然法院对于解决虚假信息问题并非完美方案，但这对那些不想被起诉的人来说是一个重大的威慑。

sentences.en: It's been shown to be effective in getting people to stop talking about Sandy Hook as a hoax or a conspiracy.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这在阻止人们将桑迪胡克事件称为骗局或阴谋方面是有效的。

sentences.en: Jones himself hasn't mentioned it on his show in years.
sentences.zh: 琼斯本人已经多年没有在节目中提及此事了。

sentences.en: So it is seen as a significant victory.
sentences.zh: 所以这被视为一场重大的胜利。

sentences.en: And that effort was led by Lenny Posner, who is the father of Noah, the youngest Sandy Hook victim,
sentences.zh: 这项努力由莱尼·波斯纳领导，他是桑迪胡克最年轻的受害者诺亚的父亲，

sentences.en: who has made it his life's work since the shooting to push for an end to misinformation around all these events.
sentences.zh: 自枪击事件以来，他将推动终结围绕所有这些事件的虚假信息作为自己毕生的事业。

sentences.en: And on the gun front, this year, they achieved a pretty significant victory in that they won a $73 million settlement from insurers for Remington,
sentences.zh: 在枪支问题上，今年他们取得了一项相当重大的胜利，他们从雷明顿的保险公司那里赢得了7300万美元的赔偿，

sentences.en: which was the maker of the rifle used in the Sandy Hook shooting.
sentences.zh: 雷明顿是桑迪胡克枪击案中所用步枪的制造商。

sentences.en: And this was seen as a significant breakthrough because there's a 2005 law that shields gun manufacturers from legal liability if their weapons are used in mass shootings.
sentences.zh: 这被视为一项重大突破，因为有一项2005年的法律保护枪支制造商免于承担大规模枪击事件的法律责任。

sentences.en: And this is seen as a significant effort to pierce that legal immunity.
sentences.zh: 这被视为打破这种法律豁免权的一项重大努力。

sentences.en: And it has inspired a lot of other lawsuits that are similar.
sentences.zh: 它也激励了许多其他类似的诉讼。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So these families have made real progress in their efforts, I'm thinking back to this phrase you used earlier, Elizabeth, to get a little bit of control over the situation.
sentences.zh: 所以这些家庭在他们的努力中取得了真正的进展，伊丽莎白，我回想起你之前用的那个短语，为了对局势获得一点点控制权。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: They've been able to use their power as the parents of children murdered at Sandy Hook to push for the change that our system and our society will allow.
sentences.zh: 他们能够利用自己作为在桑迪胡克被谋杀儿童父母的身份，去推动我们的体制和社会所允许的变革。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They would like to see more, but they have done very well with the hand they've been dealt.
sentences.zh: 他们希望能看到更多，但他们已经很好地利用了手中仅有的牌。

sentences.en: So, Elizabeth, it's now been 10 years since Sandy Hook, and given everything you told us about what lies ahead in a tragedy like this,
sentences.zh: 那么，伊丽莎白，桑迪胡克事件已经过去10年了，考虑到你告诉我们关于这类悲剧未来会发生的一切，

sentences.en: have those parents ever really been able to grieve the essential loss that they suffered, the loss of these little children?
sentences.zh: 那些父母是否真的能够哀悼他们所遭受的本质上的损失，即失去这些小孩子的痛苦？

sentences.en: Oh, I think that that is really a question for them.
sentences.zh: 哦，我认为这真的是一个属于他们自己的问题。

sentences.en: Um, that's sort of the realm that you and I and most Americans can never really enter, you know?
sentences.zh: 嗯，那是你、我和大多数美国人永远无法真正进入的领域，你知道吗？

sentences.en: It's a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 这是一件非常特殊的事情。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But from what the families have told me, this is not a start point, end point situation.
sentences.zh: 但根据家属告诉我的情况，这不是一个有起点和终点的情况。

sentences.en: They always grieve.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在哀悼。

sentences.en: This never leaves.
sentences.zh: 这种痛苦从未离开。

sentences.en: It's just good days and bad days, days where you feel like you have a little more space to do something other than grief.
sentences.zh: 只是有好日子和坏日子，有些日子你会觉得有更多的空间去做除了哀悼之外的事情。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And days where there's no space at all.
sentences.zh: 也有一些日子完全没有空间。

sentences.en: And days where, yes, there's no room at all for anything but grieving.
sentences.zh: 还有一些日子，是的，除了哀悼之外，什么都容不下。

sentences.en: Elizabeth, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, hours after the shooting, a dwindling number of families still remained inside a civic center in Uvalde,
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，枪击事件发生数小时后，仍有少数家庭留在尤瓦尔迪的一个市民中心内，

sentences.en: where parents have been receiving DNA swabs and waiting for news of their children.
sentences.zh: 家长们在那里接受DNA采样，等待着他们孩子消息。

sentences.en: Good evening, fellow Americans.
sentences.zh: 各位美国同胞，晚上好。

sentences.en: In Washington, President Biden spoke to the nation about the massacre and about the grief of the parents whose children had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 在华盛顿，拜登总统向全国发表讲话，谈到了这场大屠杀以及那些孩子被谋杀的父母的悲痛。

sentences.en: To lose a child is like having a piece of your soul ripped away.
sentences.zh: 失去孩子就像灵魂被撕裂了一块。

sentences.en: There's a hollowness in your cheSt.
sentences.zh: 你的胸口有一种空洞感。

sentences.en: You feel like you're being sucked into it and never going to be able to get out.
sentences.zh: 你感觉自己正被吸入其中，永远无法逃脱。

sentences.en: It's suffocating.
sentences.zh: 这令人窒息。

sentences.en: It's never quite the same.
sentences.zh: 一切再也回不到从前了。

sentences.en: Biden expressed outrage that so little has changed in the 10 years since the shooting at Sandy Hook.
sentences.zh: 拜登对桑迪胡克枪击案发生10年来几乎没有任何改变表示愤怒。

sentences.en: Since then, there have been over 900 incidents of gunfires reported on school grounds.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，据报道在校园内发生了超过900起枪击事件。

sentences.en: Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida.
sentences.zh: 佛罗里达州帕克兰的玛乔丽·斯通曼·道格拉斯高中。
zh_words: 玛乔丽·斯通曼·道格拉斯

sentences.en: Santa Fe High School in Texas.
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州的圣达菲高中。

sentences.en: Oxford High School in Michigan.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州的牛津高中。

sentences.en: The list goes on and on, and the list grows.
sentences.zh: 名单还在不断增加，名单越来越长。

sentences.en: Why are we willing to live with this carnage?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们愿意忍受这种杀戮？

sentences.en: Why do we keep letting this happen?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们任由这种事情不断发生？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, details about the suspected Texas shooter began to emerge.
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，关于德克萨斯州嫌疑枪手的细节开始浮出水面。

sentences.en: Uvalde is a rural community of about 15,000, where the suspect was known to many residents.
sentences.zh: 尤瓦尔迪是一个约有1.5万人口的农村社区，嫌疑人被许多居民所熟知。

sentences.en: Friends described him to journalists as an increasingly troubled 18-year-old who had been bullied over a speech impediment and had a difficult relationship with his mother.
sentences.zh: 朋友们向记者描述他是一个越来越令人担忧的18岁年轻人，曾因语言障碍而受到欺凌，与母亲的关系也很紧张。

sentences.en: Shortly before the massacre, he's believed to have shot and critically injured his grandmother, crashed a pickup truck into a barrier near the elementary school,
sentences.zh: 在大屠杀发生前不久，据信他开枪重伤了他的祖母，驾驶一辆皮卡车撞向了小学附近的一个障碍物，

sentences.en: then went inside and began shooting.
sentences.zh: 然后走进去开始射击。

sentences.en: And in the latest Republican primaries, both the governor and secretary of state in Georgia won their party's nomination,
sentences.zh: 在最新的共和党初选中，佐治亚州的州长和州务卿都赢得了党内提名，

sentences.en: beating out Republican rivals backed by Donald Trump, who denied the outcome of the 2020 election.
sentences.zh: 击败了唐纳德·特朗普支持的、否认2020年选举结果的共和党竞争对手。

sentences.en: It was Trump's biggest political setback of the 2022 primaries and a sign that his hold over the Republican Party may be slipping.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普在2022年初选中遭遇的最大政治挫折，也是他对比共和党控制力可能正在减弱的迹象。

sentences.en: Both the governor, Brian Kemp, and the secretary of state, Brad Raffensperger, won by a wide margin.
sentences.zh: 州长布莱恩·坎普和州务卿布拉德·拉芬斯珀格都以巨大优势获胜。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rachel Quester, Rob Zipko, Michael Simon-Johnson, and Chelsea Daniel.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由瑞秋·奎斯特、罗伯·齐普科、迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊和切尔西·丹尼尔制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Lisa Chow and Lisa Tobin, contains original music by Marian Lozano, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由丽莎·周和丽莎·托宾编辑，包含玛丽安·洛萨诺的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderland的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: Finally, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 最后，我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《Metro》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你收听播客的地方订阅我们。
